pairing.same_seed_limit: Pairing fixes sampling schedules, not subsequent states or actions after execution histories diverge; one collection per interface.

method.native_authority: Reuse completed native audits; cross-check SUMMARY and64 episode/root-node pairs; no native replay or model rehash.
method.checked_receipts: 64 episodes,64 root nodes,64 first calls; first requests bind actual PLAN, actor, sampling seed and initial prompt.
method.rloo: A_i = success_i - mean(other three successes); all tokens of nonzero-advantage trajectories are credited, errors included, with fixed32 episode denominator. All-success and all-failure groups have zero direct terminal-RLOO gradient; other roots can change shared parameters.
method.uncertainty: Descriptive eight-root paired analysis. No p-value or interval treating32 attempts as independent; shared recipes and one collection per interface limit generalization.
method.signal_limit: Equal mixed-group counts do not mean identical or equally useful gradients. Identities, signs, paths and token exposures change; these are available reward contrasts, not measured gradient quality or transfer.

limitations: Same example-trained warm actor, official TRAIN A goals and one shared recipe world: no learned improvement, held-out generalization or recursion result.
Binder changes executed ingredient arguments and downstream histories; this is the whole execution intervention, not an isolated action effect or evidence the model learned correct arguments.
Calls and tokens fall overall, not on every goal. Native errors fall while schema errors rise. Service time sums request durations; it is not allocation wall time or training cost.
Post-quantity calls include ordinary finishing and arise on a larger successful subset with binder;23 versus44 does not show termination worsened.
Original sampled tokens retain terminal-advantage sign, errors included; binder-rewritten arguments are environment transitions, not training targets.
advisor_recommendation: Keep this in the reading guide/next decision until fixed RL and extra-SFT readouts complete. It reinforces execution-assistance evidence and refines the reward-signal diagnosis; it does not establish a new learning gain.
interpretation: Code assistance helps the unchanged warm actor complete these A tasks with fewer aggregate calls/tokens, but the four common all-failure roots still supply no direct terminal-RLOO contrast.
Mixed groups remain3/8 while their identities, reward signs, trajectories and token exposures change. This does not establish identical or equally useful gradients.

The observed ingredient-error reduction and inventory-error increase concern the whole altered execution process. Native validation checks ingredient arguments before inventory, so error redistribution alone cannot show worsening stock reasoning.
